settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Choose the letter count, difficulty, guess mode, and accent accuracy for your next round.
settings.difficultyHelp: Easy uses common words. Hard adds less common and technical words. Expert adds regional and rare words.
settings.accuracyHelp: A wrong accent can be yellow in either setting. If omitted accents are allowed, an unaccented letter in the right place can be green. For example, “hữu co” matches “hữu cơ”.

wordGame.helpLegacyDictionary: Dictionary mode checks the round’s word list and blocks eliminated letters. Free mode takes any valid sequence and lets you reuse eliminated letters.
